claims.statement: An advertisement gave Tom Allen's place as 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with a free concert every evening.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street.

claims.statement: Tom Allen styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street.

notes: Only a saloon advertisement. The Smith-White, Creedon and other sporting items do not involve Allen.
